name: valutavalto-monorepo
description: Exclusive Best Change Zrt. - teljes valutavalto ERP okoszisztema (backend + frontend-react + penztar-client)

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://localhost:3000 -t 180000 && cd penztar-client && npx vite
scripts.test: concurrently -n frontend,penztar -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix frontend-react test" "npm --prefix penztar-client test"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend-react run typecheck && npm --prefix penztar-client run typecheck
scripts.lint: concurrently -n frontend,penztar "npm --prefix frontend-react run lint" "npm --prefix penztar-client run lint"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:penztar
